note: City of Papillion recreation area at 9902 Schram Rd, south of Hwy 370 west of 96th St. The campground loops sit west of the park road; a small pond (about 3 acres on imagery) lies beside the east loop, and the 105-acre Walnut Creek Lake is across the road to the east. Camp host 402-679-9889. --Claude
summary: Operator page (2026-10-16 read; Cloudflare-blocked today) confirms 44 electric 30/50-amp sites on 55-ft concrete pads, city water, dump, FCFS only, $20/night or $120/week, 2-week limit; groups upgraded from note prose to manual, max_rig 55 added. Imagery: the RV loops are not on the 105-acre lake (across the park road, 250 m+); the water beside the east loop is a ~3.4-acre pond. Waterfront lead lakefront -> pond or not waterfront (see flags). Pin at the host/entrance end, ~150 m from the loops' centre: OK. Season not stated.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (re-audit, stored lakefront): the stored evidence ('eastern/northern RV pads ~30-50 m from Walnut Creek Lake cove') describes a separate pond, not the lake. On Esri imagery (2026-11-04) the water beside the east loop is a pond west of the park road, flood-filled at about 3.4 acres (13,700 m2, under the ~5-acre line, so it is a pond); the 105-acre Walnut Creek Lake lies east of the road and 250 m+ from any pad. Three or four east-side pads (the spurs off the east leg of the loop) sit about 37-57 m from the pond's high-water edge across open, unmown meadow with only a thin brush fringe at the shore and no road between. lakefront is wrong either way: 'pond' if AWH counts ~40 m of open meadow from 3-4 pads as on the pond, otherwise 'not waterfront' (there is no pond-view). My read: borderline at the ~50 m bound, so default down to not waterfront unless AWH prefers pond.

The operator page (papillion.org) is behind a Cloudflare block for both curl and the headless browser on 2026-11-04; facts rest on the 2026-10-16 browser read saved in audit/price_research/local_browser_2026-10-16/browser.jsonl. No season statement on that read.
